title: ACME Insurance KPI dataset (real seed)
description: Schema sidecar for insurance_kpis_2020_2024.csv. Maps each column to a 'kind' (stock / flow / rate / snapshot) so the Phase 8 executor can refuse nonsensical aggregations without the LLM ever being asked. The CSV is sparse - one row per (year, month, channel, product_line) cycling through combos - plus two pre-aggregated annual rollup rows where channel='All' and product_line='All' (2020-ANNUAL and 2024-ANNUAL only). Treat the rollup rows as cross-check fixtures; the executor excludes them by default when running aggregations to avoid double-counting.

year.description: Reuses settings.kb_covered_years. Year 2023 is intentionally absent - executor raises OperationViolation(reason="year_gap") for queries that target it.

period.description: Monthly rows use YYYY-MM. Two pre-aggregated annual rollup rows exist for 2020 and 2024 only - executor filters them out unless explicitly requested.

channel.description: Three sales channels. The literal value 'All' only appears on the annual-rollup rows.

product_line.description: Four lines of business. The literal value 'All' only appears on the annual-rollup rows.

policies_in_force.description: End-of-period stock. Do NOT sum across periods (each row already carries the running total at that period's end).

new_policies.description: Period flow. Sum freely across periods and dimensions.

renewal_rate_pct.description: Percentage of eligible policies that renewed in the period. Aggregate with weighted_mean using policies_in_force as the weight - sum is meaningless.

gross_written_premium_eur.description: Total GWP in EUR (NOT thousands - full units). Sum freely across periods.

claims_reported.description: Number of new claims reported during the period (count).

claims_paid_eur.description: Total EUR paid out on claims in the period (monetary - distinct from claims_reported which is a count).

avg_claim_settlement_days.description: Average number of days to settle a claim, computed over claims paid in the period. Aggregate across periods with weighted_mean using claims_reported as the weight.

loss_ratio_pct.description: Claims paid / gross written premium, as a percentage. Aggregate with weighted_mean using gross_written_premium_eur as the weight - sum is meaningless.

nps_score.description: Net Promoter Score snapshot at end of period. Aggregate with mean or weighted_mean by policies_in_force across channels.

operating_expense_eur.description: Total operating expense for the period (salaries + IT + marketing - everything except claims paid).

digital_adoption_pct.description: Percentage of new_policies and claims filed via digital channels. Aggregate with weighted_mean using new_policies as the weight.

comment: The executor reads valid_aggregations[metric.kind] and rejects any aggregation not in the list. This is the one place where domain rules live - the planner LLM never sees this list, it sees only the metric names and dimension domains via the prompt.
